products.title: Marilyn Monroe Bubble Gum
products.short_description: A playful Marilyn Monroe portrait with a bold pink bubble-gum focal point. Beginner-friendly full cross stitch, 100 × 120 stitches and 19 DMC colours.
products.description:
Marilyn Monroe Bubble Gum is a modern digital cross-stitch portrait built around warm neutral tones and a vivid pink bubble-gum accent.

The 17-page PDF includes a finished-design preview, pattern facts, a 19-colour DMC key with stitch counts, full-colour and black-and-white chart overviews, four enlarged colour chart sections, four enlarged symbol chart sections, and a print-and-stitch guide.

Pattern details: 100 × 120 stitches; 7,927 total stitches; 19 DMC colours; full cross stitches only; beginner friendly. Finished area: 18.1 × 21.8 cm on 14 ct, 15.9 × 19.1 cm on 16 ct, or 14.1 × 16.9 cm on 18 ct Aida.

This is a digital PDF pattern. No physical item is shipped. Personal use only.

products.title: Audrey Hepburn Elegant Profile
products.short_description: An elegant Audrey Hepburn profile portrait with a dark updo, black dress and pink lip accents. Beginner-friendly full cross stitch, 100 × 120 stitches and 19 DMC colours.
products.description:
Audrey Hepburn Elegant Profile is a modern digital cross-stitch portrait. An elegant Audrey Hepburn profile portrait with a dark updo, black dress and pink lip accents.

The 17-page PDF includes a finished-design preview, pattern facts, a 19-colour DMC key with stitch counts, full-colour and black-and-white chart overviews, four enlarged colour chart sections, four enlarged symbol chart sections, and a print-and-stitch guide.

Pattern details: 100 × 120 stitches; 5,817 total stitches; 19 DMC colours; full cross stitches only; beginner friendly. Finished area: 18.1 × 21.8 cm on 14 ct, 15.9 × 19.1 cm on 16 ct, or 14.1 × 16.9 cm on 18 ct Aida.

This is a digital PDF pattern. No physical item is shipped. Personal use only.
